annotations.title: Extract Custom JSON Schema from Document

description: Extract nested, typed JSON fields matching a caller-defined `schema` from a single PDF or image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TIFF; max 15 MB) in memory without storing files. Use when you need structured key-value or nested object/array fields (e.g., invoice headers, serial numbers, or vendor bill expense vs. item cost distributions). Do NOT use for schema-free 2D spreadsheet/CSV exports (`extract_document_table`), verbatim plain-text OCR (`extract_document_text`), multiple documents at once (`extract_document_batch`), or async webhook jobs (`submit_document_job`). Consumes 1 credit per page with `api_key`, or 1 of 2 free daily anonymous extractions when omitted.

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`). Falls back to the `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` request header; if none is supplied, uses the anonymous free tier (2 documents/day per IP).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes (raw base64 or `data:<mime>;base64,...` URI, max 15 MB decoded). Mutually exclusive with `file_url` — provide exactly one.

file_name.description: Optional original filename with extension (e.g., `"vendor-bill.pdf"`) used for audit logging when passing `file_base64`. Defaults to `"document.pdf"`.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or TIFF document (max 15 MB). Mutually exclusive with `file_base64` — provide exactly one.

schema.description: Non-empty target JSON template or JSON Schema defining the exact field names and types to extract (e.g., `{"vendorName":"string","invoiceNumber":"string","totalAmount":"number","lineItems":[{"description":"string","amount":"number"}]}`).

name: extract_document_json

confidenceScore.description: Extraction confidence score from 0 to 100 (100 for native digital PDFs, 95 for OCR).

creditsRemaining.description: Remaining API key page credits after deduction (present when authenticated with `api_key`).

extractedData.description: Extracted document fields conforming to the caller-supplied `schema`.

freeQuotaRemainingToday.description: Remaining anonymous free-tier documents today (present when called without `api_key`).

processedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when extraction completed.
